project.description: Project identifier shared by the team, as recorded in the project knowledge.

prefix.description: Prefix of task numbers; a personal setting of the operator.

knowledge.description: Absolute path of the project knowledge repository.

knowledge_created.description: Whether this call created the project knowledge: wrote and committed its project information.

main_worktree.description: Absolute path of the main worktree of the project.

worktrees.description: Worktrees this call added to the pool: the main one and the one the command ran in; empty when nothing changed.

action.description: What happened: added or unchanged. The list is open: a client shows an unknown value as is.

agents.description: What the layout of subagents in the worktrees added did; present only when there is something to tell.
